title: L2 Domain Semantics (v2 — executable reduction graph)
description: The SETTLED domain-semantics contract, version 2: a deterministic, hashed executable reduction graph machine-emitted (neutrino-emit --kind=domain-semantics) from the verified generic l2 meta-model. RECONCILIATION (): this SUPERSEDES neutrino.l2-domain-semantics/v1 (the hand-authored descriptive form — concepts + concept-local traces + evidence/guards). Same kind, explicitly versioned: v1 is retained as the legacy descriptive artifact (validated by validate_l2_domain_semantics.py, schemaVersion 1) pending migration; v2 is the authoritative executable-graph artifact (validate_l2_domain_semantics_v2.py, schemaVersion 2). neutrino.domain-dialect/v1 is retained ONLY as the reviewed vocabulary/source artifact. No third overlapping semantic model is introduced. Bytes are byte-reproducible: sorted keys, records sorted by full canonical form, no timestamps. domainSemanticsHash = lowercase sha256 over the compact canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators=(',',':')) of this object with the hash field removed. A conforming consumer MUST additionally enforce the cross-record contract (identity uniqueness, endpoint resolution, per-concept supported traceability, descriptive/executable restriction, accepted provenance for behaviour-driving edges, provenance subject resolution, invariant failure-mode references) — see validate_l2_domain_semantics_v2.py.

imports.description: Versioned imports of OTHER L2 domains (l2.import records): a foreign capability at a required version, resolved against a domain registry by the import resolver. Part of the hashed contract, so an import change bites domainSemanticsHash. A capability is imported at most once.
